# 5 Star Craft & Construction

> Creating beautiful spaces, built around you. A Knysna-based carpentry and construction company led by Clive, serving the Garden Route — custom kitchens, built-in cupboards and wardrobes, bespoke furniture, wooden flooring, shelving, tiling, painting, and custom interior spaces and renovations.

## Services
- Kitchen units: custom kitchens designed, built and fitted
- Built-in cabinets: cupboards and storage made to measure
- Wardrobes: fitted wardrobes with shelving and lighting
- Coffee tables: bespoke handcrafted timber furniture
- Wooden flooring: installation, sanding and sealing
- Shelving: floating shelves, bookcases, display shelving
- General carpentry work: repairs, fitments, finishing
- Tiling: floors, walls, kitchens and bathrooms
- Painting: interior and exterior
- Custom interior spaces and renovations: full transformations managed start to finish

## Service Areas
Knysna · Plettenberg Bay · George · Wilderness · Sedgefield · Mossel Bay · Greater Western Cape (on request)
